notes:
Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (customer success/product analytics) evaluating Redwood. Started on Hosted API POC for chat + embeddings; strong interest in Dedicated/VPC for production due to customer data controls. Security team requires SOC2 Type II evidence, SAML SSO with Okta, audit logging, and customer-managed KMS.

POC details:
- Jan 18: POC kickoff (hosted API) — baseline integration (chat + indexer) running against anonymized datasets.
- Early results: latency P95 ~ 140ms on small test flows, token cost higher than expected for high-volume prompts. Team exploring routing to smaller models for low-cost flows.
- Throughput target: 80-120 chats/sec (mixed), 400–800 embeddings/day for nightly batch jobs.
- Latency SLO: 150ms P95 for short conversational queries; cost-sensitive for bulk embedding jobs.

Security/Compliance:
- Quote from Head of Security: "We need SOC2 Type II and SAML SSO; audit logs must be tamper-evident and retained for at least 12 months. No exceptions without legal sign-off."
- Requirements: VPC peering or PrivateLink, customer KMS (BYOK), per-route audit logs, log retention controls (configurable), ability to redact PII from logs, data residency in US/EU.
- Current blocker: legal asking for clear SLA on data deletion + demonstrable key management flow (HSM vs software KMS).

Commercial:
- Interested in moving from Hosted to Dedicated once security ticks are validated. They want committed reserved capacity pricing (monthly) but need a clear unit cost comparison to hosted usage.
- Procurement engagement expected if security deep-dive is satisfactory. Estimated ARR 50k–150k depending on committed throughput.

Operational notes / loose items:
- SE (Priya) to run Dedicated sizing exercise (GPU types, quantization tradeoffs) — Pelican wants guidance on model/quantization mix to hit cost targets.
- Ask: provide playbook for routing policies (latency vs cost) + example configs for canary rollouts.
- Requested artifacts: SOC2 report, SAML integration guide (Okta examples), sample audit log export, pricing scenario spreadsheet.

Stubs/links: Fireflies meetings above; shared drive has security packet + pricing deck. Jira INF-4213 raised for dedicated-sizing questions.

Short-term next steps (internal):
- Send SOC2 artifact + SAML integration doc to Pelican security (by 2026-03-03).
- Schedule architecture + security deep-dive (SE + Infra + Security) week of 2026-03-08.
- Prepare pricing scenarios for 1/3/6/12 month reserved commitments and delta to hosted consumption.
